notes.title: Saviorless 1.1.0: Available NOW!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39019599/9476ad5d7e2430ca74d0ecda9243825b7cb966e1.jpg[/img]

[h2]Saviorless 1.1.0: Dive Back In and Uncover the Secrets![/h2]
 
[h3]We're thrilled to unleash Saviorless 1.1.0, bringing a fresh wave of exploration, challenge refinement, and a touch of bug squashing.[/h3]
 
[h3]Unveil the Lost Pages, Unlock the True Ending[/h3]
[list]
[*] The mysteries of the world deepen! A brand new level select menu lets you revisit conquered territories. Seek out the hidden Lost Pages scattered throughout, the key to unlocking the game's secret ending. Prepare to delve back into the shadows and unearth the truth!
[/list]
[h3]Strategic Checkpoints:  Save Your Sanity (and Time)[/h3]
[list]
[*] No more frustration! We've implemented numerous checkpoints across the world. Now, when Antar meets his demise (because, let's face it, he will), you'll re-spawn closer to the action, minimising the backtracking blues.
[/list]
[h3]Difficulty Curve Makeover: [/h3]
[list]
[*] We've heard your cries (and screams)! The difficulty curve has been meticulously adjusted, offering a smoother and more balanced game-play experience. Prepare for a challenge!
[/list]
[h3]Steam Players Rejoice! [/h3]
We've vanquished those pesky Steam Achievement bugs! 
[list]
[*] No more waiting for the game to close to see your hard-earned badges. 
[*] Achievements now unlock as soon as you complete them. 
[*] Additionally, the "The Next Narrator" achievement should now unlock automatically if you've already completed all the others. Just boot up the game and witness its glorious arrival! 
[/list]
[h3] We hope you enjoy exploring the depths of Saviorless v1.1.0. 
As always, your feedback fuels our flames. Keep it coming![/h3]

notes.title: After eight years, this Hollow Knight style platformer is finally out
notes.notes:
If there's one game we're all waiting on, it's Hollow Knight Silksong. The highly anticipated sequel to 2017's hit Metroidvania has us all on the edge of our seats, hoping and praying that we'll catch a glimpse of the mysterious princess in action, needle-like blade at the ready. With no launch date in sight, though, I've been looking for something equally as creepy to keep me occupied, and new platformer Saviorless is exactly what I've been needing.

Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: Stunning new indie game is like a surreal, dark fantasy Hollow Knight
notes.notes:
Blending those stylish 2D action platformer boss fights of Hollow Knight and Blasphemous 2 with a captivating dark fantasy world and hand-drawn animation, Saviorless has very much caught my eye ahead of its imminent release date on Steam. This new indie game from Cuban developer Empty Head Games has an immediately striking look to it, inspired by classic 16-bit aesthetics but with a more realistic twist, and its gorgeous worlds and high-octane boss fights look like a surreal and mystical experience.

Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: Cuban dark fantasy metroidvania Saviorless gets an April release date
notes.notes:
If you're fond of the fairly specific blend of doomy theology, rich art direction and Soulslike-tinted metroidvaning encapsulated by Blasphemous, you might also enjoy Saviorless from Cuban team Empty Head Games and publisher Dear Villagers, which now has a PC release date of 2nd April.

notes.title: Savior - Gameplay sneak peek
notes.notes:
With the Steam Next Fest ending last monday we've seen a lot more people playing the demo. Thanks everybody for trying Saviorless and giving your feedbacks! Our journey is not over yet, let's take a look at how Savior's gameplay look and play for people that haven't played the demo:

Use the destructive powers of Antar's Savior to face the terrible threat represented by Nento and his group of hunters. To transform in and out of the Savior you'll have to pass through these gate:

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40469584/f118b95f0ad23785b75ac95e8665ca02d30ef8fe.gif[/img]

Move faster and dash on longer distances in Savior mode.

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40469584/afd5117ddf3f887e6e129229e2bf8794f3f1fb5a.gif[/img]

But your movement are not the only things changing when playing the Savior. Antar might be a fragile boy, as a Savior you don't have this limitation. Fight your way through waves of foes and clean the Smiling Isles.

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40469584/679b7cb814822d388715c2b647e45f4bf770f4ab.gif[/img]

Your time is running out, watch out for the gauge on top of your character. Kill your foes and destroy statues to stay alive or face dire consequences.

If you want to get all the update about Saviorless follow and wishlist the game!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1438480/Saviorless/

notes.title: Antar's gameplay
notes.notes:
As you know Saviorless features 2 completely different gameplay: Antar the boy and the Savior, a violent masked avatar.
Today let's take a look at how Antar's gameplay look. 

Discover the Smiling Island as you go through each environment of this paradisiacal place. 

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40469584/df82a5ce7e5405390a9622b2f81770f6c4ed0f88.gif[/img]

Or at least that's what the legend said. The Smiling Islands are all but heaven. You will face dangers that are too much for an ill-prepared boy like Antar. When facing monster you should always avoid monsters or at least find a way to make them go away...

notes.title: Antar's story
notes.notes:
Antar is a mysterious and taciturn boy about whom little is known. Both his past and his place of origin are veiled in the darkest secret. Without really knowing why, almost as if some external force were driving him, all his energies are focused on the obsessive search for the Smiling Islands in order to obtain the supernatural powers of a Savior. 

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40469584/ea453af738401c99a41a688fafb881bacbc623e4.gif[/img]

notes.title: Saviorless' world
notes.notes:
Upon arrival to the Smiling Islands Antar shockingly discovers that the whole place is just a ruined wasteland full of terrible monsters and all sorts of deadly threats, where Saviors are forced to kill each other, to remain alive. It is suspected that the one to blame for the calamitous state of the islands is the hunter known as Nento, who purposely dismissed the guidance of the Radiant Heron to enter the place on his own.  

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40469584/9f0bd9e2f5cc7f151e6e5ab6c432106baa8d248e.gif[/img]

notes.title: The tale of Antar
notes.notes:
In an old tale narrated by three travelers, a child named Antar enters a forbidden beach looking for a Radiant Heron that can lead her into a miraculous place known as the Smiling Islands. The legend says that the adventurer who manages to get to this paradisiac place will be reborn as a "Savior", an extremely powerful and immortal god-like creature. 

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40469584/e551c0d2d1f06be9678493982d35bbb168e83c6a.png[/img]

After making an irreversible covenant that throws her into the islands, the child gets her new powers as Savior, a disposable avatar who is far from being immortal, and discovers the islands are a hell of no return designed to confront the arriving newcomers.
